title_en: Supreme People's Court's Three Typical Cases of Child Trafficking Crimes
keywords_en: Court concerning child abduction and trafficking cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Three Typical Cases of Child Trafficking Crimes

Case 1: Li Fengying et al. Child Trafficking Case

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Li Fengying, female, Han ethnicity, born October 26, 1955, farmer.

Defendant Xu Yuanli, male, Han ethnicity, born June 22, 1968, farmer.

Defendant Wan Yulian, female, Han ethnicity, born November 18, 1963, farmer.

Defendant Pan Cunzhi, female, Han ethnicity, born February 15, 1963, farmer.

Defendant Gao Huailing, female, Han ethnicity, born May 2, 1965, farmer.

From August 2007 to June 2009, defendant Li Fengying purchased large quantities of infants and young children from traffickers from other regions, and later sold them to defendant Xu Yuanli in Zaozhuang City, Shandong Province. Xu Yuanli resold the infants and young children at a markup to defendant Wan Yulian, who, through Pan Cunzhi, Gao Huailing, Ma Guangling, Li Xiurong, and Sun Jinying (all co-defendants who have been sentenced), sold the infants and young children to residents of Yicheng District, Shizhong District, Xuecheng District and other areas of Zaozhuang City for adoption, for the purpose of profit. Among them, Li Fengying, Xu Yuanli, and Wan Yulian participated in 37 instances, trafficking 38 children; Pan Cunzhi participated in 9 instances, trafficking 9 children; Gao Huailing participated in 6 instances, trafficking 6 children. The origins of the trafficked children were unknown; after the case was solved, they were all rescued.

(2) Judgment

The court held that defendants Li Fengying, Xu Yuanli, Wan Yulian, Pan Cunzhi, Gao Huailing, and others, with the purpose of selling, trafficked children, and their conduct constituted the crime of child trafficking. Li Fengying, Xu Yuanli, and Wan Yulian trafficked a large number of children, the circumstances were especially serious, and they should be severely punished according to law. Pan Cunzhi and Gao Huailing had a relatively good attitude in admitting guilt, and could be given a lighter punishment as appropriate. Based on this, the court sentenced defendants Li Fengying, Xu Yuanli, and Wan Yulian to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, deprivation of political rights for life, and confiscation of all personal property for the crime of child trafficking; and sentenced Pan Cunzhi and Gao Huailing to fixed-term imprisonment of fifteen years and thirteen years respectively, and imposed fines for the crime of child trafficking.

Case 2: Wu Yajun, Guan Qianqian Child Trafficking Case

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Wu Yajun, male, Han ethnicity, born July 7, 1984, farmer.

Defendant Guan Qianqian, female, Han ethnicity, born April 28, 1988, farmer.

Defendant Guan Qianqian gave birth to a baby boy on February 8, 2009. Later, because the child was often sick and the family had financial difficulties, the two defendants, Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian, a married couple, decided to give the child away. In early June of the same year, Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian approached Qiao Yu, a nurse at Xianping Red Cross Hospital in Linfen City, Shanxi Province, and asked her to help make arrangements. The next day, Qiao Yu informed Zhang Yongzhen of this matter, and Zhang Yongzhen in turn asked Duan Maicun (a co-defendant who has been sentenced) to inquire about the situation. After contacting Guan Qianqian by telephone, Duan Maicun agreed to pay Guan Qianqian RMB 26,000. Later, Duan Maicun informed Jing Jiuju (a co-defendant who has been sentenced) of this situation. After Jing Jiuju contacted Zhao Linzhen (a co-defendant who has been sentenced) and examined the child, Zhao Linzhen, through Guo Qiuping (a co-defendant who has been sentenced), found a buyer. On June 13 of the same year, at Zhao Linzhen's home, Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian sold the child, who was only four months old, to Cai Huaiguang (at large) for RMB 26,000. Zhao Linzhen, Jing Jiuju, Duan Maicun, and Guo Qiuping profited RMB 1,400, RMB 600, RMB 500, and RMB 1,500 respectively. Zhao Linzhen, Guo Qiuping, and Wang Hongsheng (a co-defendant who has been sentenced) together took the infant to Taierzhuang, Shandong Province. The case came to light after Wu Yajun's father reported to the public security authorities that his grandson had been sold by Wu Yajun and his wife. On July 17 of the same year, the public security authorities successfully rescued the trafficked infant.

(2) Judgment

The court held that defendants Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian sold a baby boy who was only four months old to others for RMB 26,000, and their conduct constituted the crime of child trafficking. Regarding the defendants' argument that their conduct was a private placement of the child for adoption and did not constitute a crime, the court found that, without understanding the basic conditions of the other party, and without considering whether the other party had the purpose or ability to raise the child, Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian gave the child to others to receive a large sum of money that was clearly not for nutritional expenses. This could be determined as selling their own biological son, and should be punished as the crime of child trafficking; their argument could not stand. Because Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian sold the child due to family financial difficulties, and the child was subsequently successfully rescued by the public security authorities, resulting in no serious social harm, their subjective culpability was relatively minor, and the circumstances of the crime were relatively light. Accordingly, the court sentenced defendants Wu Yajun and Guan Qianqian to fixed-term imprisonment of three years, with a five-year suspension of execution, and imposed a fine of RMB 30,000 each for the crime of child trafficking.

Case 3: Peng Chengkun, Meng Fanjun Purchasing Trafficked Children Case

(1) Basic Facts

Defendant Peng Chengkun, male, Han ethnicity, born November 14, 1973, farmer.

Defendant Meng Fanjun, female, Han ethnicity, born May 19, 1971, farmer.

Between 2006 and 2009, Wang Caiyun, Hu Zunzhi, Liu Xia, Pang Zifen, Chen Fuguo, Liu Qingfen, Chen Fugang (all have been sentenced) and others, in the urban area of Linyi City, Linshu County, and other places in Shandong Province, formed loose groups and trafficked 18 children for illegal profit. Among them, in October 2009, defendants Peng Chengkun and Meng Fanjun, introduced by Zuo Zhenyou and with the assistance of Chen Fuguo, purchased a baby boy from Wang Caiyun for RMB 44,000 to raise. After the case was solved, the trafficked child was rescued.

(2) Judgment

The court held that defendants Peng Chengkun and Meng Fanjun purchased trafficked children, and their conduct constituted the crime of purchasing trafficked children. In view of the fact that the two defendants did not abuse or mistreat the child they purchased, and did not obstruct the public security authorities during the rescue, the court gave them a lighter punishment as appropriate, and sentenced each of them to fixed-term imprisonment of one year, with a two-year suspension of execution.
